sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio
Arrived at HQ. Debriefing with night shift.
Gearing up. Night shift finished dealing with a police event at Britomart; will make effort to head down towards Britomart for welfare checks.
Commencing patrol. Heading towards Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square, commencing sweep of the area.
Sweep completed. Standing by for security presence.
Heading towards the Library for welfare checks.
Library area all clear. Heading towards SkyCity via Wellesley St.
Business welfare checks, all clear. Standing by for security presence:
Cathedral all clear. Checking in at the corner of Albert and Wyndham St.
Corner of Albert and Wyndham St all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Heading towards Victoria St via Albert St.
Heading down Victoria St towards Elliot and Darby St.
Elliot and Darby St all clear. Heading towards Lorne St via Wellesley St.
Lorne St all clear. Heading through High St.
High St all clear. Checking in on O'Connell St, Freyberg Square and Chancery Square.
All areas all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Welfare checks, all clear — standing by at Jo&Joes:
Heading to check in on Gore St.
Gore St all clear, including Auckland Harbour Suites and Smiley Mart. Heading towards Britomart McDonald's.
Welfare check on Britomart McDonald's — all clear, no issues. Standing by for security presence.
Commercial Bay all clear. Heading towards Albert St.
Aotea Gift and Woolworths all clear. Heading up Albert St.
Albert Mart all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Received a response call from Bhan Mi Queen St. Heading to assist.
Removed the female vagrant POI from Bhan Mi Queen St. Standing by for security presence. (photo on file)
Heading down Queen St towards Britomart.
Welfare checks from McDonald's Queen St to Lovisa — all stores clear, no issues. Standing by for security presence.
Stores from Lovisa to JB Hi-Fi, Kathmandu and Macpac all clear. Checking in on Chemist Warehouse.
Chemist Warehouse all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Vulcan Lane all clear. Continuing towards Britomart.
Arrived at Q Convenience. All stores from Sailaway Souvenirs to Q Convenience all clear. Heading to Britomart McDonald's.
Area all clear. Standing by for security presence.
Received a call from Queen St McDonald's requesting assistance. Heading to location.
Removed the vagrant from the promotional window of McDonald's Queen St. Standing by for security presence. (video on file)
Heading to do last welfare checks on surrounding stores before going on break.
Received a call from Cotton On about a female vagrant who may potentially steal. Heading to assist.
The POI left. No issues to report. Standing by for security presence.
All stores from the corner of Queen St and Victoria St to Wellesley St and Queen St all clear. Arrived at the office for break.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Arrived at headquarters, handover completed with morning shift, equipment checked. Standing by charging Ops phone due to low battery.
Ops phone sufficiently charged. Commencing patrols from headquarters onto Queen St, starting with the upper Queen St areas.
Welfare checks completed, all clear — checked up on staff, no issues:
Welfare checks completed, all clear — checked up on staff, no issues:
Full sweep of Darby St — all clear, no issues. Welfare check completed on Recycle Boutique — all clear, no issues.
Full sweep of Elliot St — all clear, no issues.
Welfare check completed on Elliot Stables — checked up on staff, no issues. Making our way to Aotea Square via Wellesley St West and Albert St.
Full sweep of Wellesley St West — all clear, no issues.
Full sweep of Albert St — all clear, no issues.
Arrived at Aotea Square, commencing sweep.
Full sweep of Aotea Square completed. Standing by due to heavy foot traffic in the area.
Crossing from Aotea Square to Lorne St for a full sweep.
Full sweep of Lorne St completed. Heading to High St via Victoria St East.
Upper Queen St areas completed; commencing patrols for the Lower Queen St areas.
Welfare check completed on Looksharp, Victoria St.
Welfare check completed on Two Dollar Things, High St.
Welfare check completed on Tattys Designer, High St.
Full sweep of Chancery Square — all clear, no issues.
Full sweep of Vulcan Lane completed — no issues.
Full sweep of Fort St and Fort Lane completed. Welfare check completed on Jo&Joes — checked up on staff, no issues.

Received a response call from YOYOSO regarding a shoplifter who stole items from their store; the individual had left the store 20 minutes prior. Requested footage due to the lack of description given by the staff member. (photo on file)
Full sweep of Customs St East, Customs St West and the convenience store on Customs St — all clear, no issues.
Arrived at Commercial Bay, commencing a full sweep.

During the sweep of Commercial Bay, received a response call from YOYOSO management advising they have sent photos of the POI to the WhatsApp number. Keeping an eye out for the individual; no further issues to report.
Full sweep of Commercial Bay completed. Welfare check completed on Britomart McDonald's — checked up on staff, no issues. Standing by maintaining presence.
Received a response call from Daily Drip cafe on Queen St (near Cotton On) regarding an altercation; unsure if any physical violence was involved. Making our way over now.
Walking up towards Daily Drip from Commercial Bay, arrived just in front of headquarters to find Police already on scene handling the situation. Assisted Police with crowd control. (photo on file)

Received a call from management regarding the same situation Police were handling; informed them we were already on scene assisting with crowd control. Management also directed us to Swanson St to deal with a situation regarding suspicious activity in the area.
Police have left the scene. Heading over to Swanson St.
Full sweep of Swanson St — all clear, no issues, no suspicious activity in the area.

Called management back to advise the Swanson St sweep was complete with no suspicious activity and no further issues. Heading back to headquarters to charge the Ops phone (low battery) and catch up on the report.
Arrived at headquarters. Charging Ops phone.
Ops phone charged to a sufficient level. Commencing patrols, making our way to Aotea Square for a full sweep.
Welfare check completed on Queen St McDonald's — checked up on staff, no issues.
Full sweep of Darby St — all clear, no issues.
Full sweep of Elliot St — all clear, no issues. Welfare check on Elliot Stables — staff were fine, no issues.
Arrived at Commercial Bay, commencing full sweep.
Full sweep of Commercial Bay completed — no issues. Standing by maintaining presence due to heavy foot traffic in both Aotea Square and Queen St.
Heading back to headquarters for floor checks.
Arrived at headquarters, commencing floor checks.
Floor checks completed. Starting 30-minute scheduled break.
Afternoon shift completed. Equipment checked and returned. Handover to night shift.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:43 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Body Cameras, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone
Heading out for patrols. Going down Queen St.
Arrived at Chemist Warehouse on Wyndham St. Vagrants spotted in the area seeking shelter. Moving on.
Arrived at Shortland St. Quick sweep done in the area; little to no foot traffic at this time. Moving on.
Arrived at TK Square, carrying out sweep in the area.
Sweep concluded. Moderate foot traffic in the area. Will go on to carry out a welfare check at Britomart McDonald's.
Welfare check on Britomart McDonald's concluded. Only report of concern received was regarding a suspicious male. Standing by to show presence and await response calls.
McDonald's Britomart all clear. The male reported has not shown face again at this time. Staff advised to call us if he returns. Continuing patrols, cutting through Customs St East towards Gore St.
Gore St all clear. Continuing down Fort St towards Fort Lane.
Fort St all clear. A quick sweep down Fort Lane was conducted as well — no issues to report. Continuing down High St.
Vulcan Lane all clear. Moderate foot traffic in the area, no concerns. Moving on.
Arrived at Freyberg Square, conducting a sweep.
Sweep concluded in Freyberg Square. Area has the most foot traffic thus far in our patrols. Standing by awaiting response calls.
Freyberg Square all clear. No issues despite the volume of civilians in the area. Continuing patrols.
Durham St East all clear. Little to no activity in the area at this time. Moving on.
Arrived at the Victoria St East intersection — all clear. Continuing towards Lorne St.
Lorne St all clear, no issues to report. Cutting through Rutland St and back onto Queen St.
Back on Queen St. Heading over to Aotea Square.
Sweep done at Aotea Square. Area is busier than usual — busiest checkpoint thus far throughout patrols. Standing by showing presence and awaiting response calls.
Aotea Square all clear. Area is busy for a Sunday evening, however no trouble is present fortunately. Moving along back onto Queen St towards the Civic.
Arrived at the Civic. Foot traffic slowing down as we head down. No issues to report. Moving along up Wellesley St West and down Elliott St.
Arrived at Elliott St. Conducting a sweep of Elliott St and Darby St.
Elliott St and Darby St all clear. Heading towards Queen St McDonald's for a welfare check.
Queen St McDonald's all clear. Staff had no issues to relay. Heading back to HQ to conduct floor checks.
Floor checks completed. Standing by at HQ to charge the Ops phone and awaiting response calls.
Phone charged sufficiently to continue patrols. Heading up Queen St.
Welfare check on Queen St McDonald's — staff are fine, no issues reported. Moving along towards Victoria St West.
Arrived at Victoria St West, heading up towards Albert St. Little to no foot traffic in the area.
Arrived at Albert St. Area secured and clear, no activity present. Continuing towards Federal St.
Conducting a sweep throughout Federal St.
Federal St all clear. Heading towards 77 Convenience Store.
77 Convenience Store good and well. Staff reported the usual vagrants sitting outside — no harm or disturbances caused, just present in the area. Heading back down Victoria St West onto Queen St.
Back on Queen St, heading south.
Wyndham St all clear. Area is relatively empty. Moving along.
Shortland St all clear. Heading towards TK Square.
Arrived at TK Square, conducting a sweep of the area.
TK Square all clear. Heading back to HQ for our break and handover with the morning team.
Handover with morning team completed. Night shift concluded.
